name: Raigad Samadhi (Raigad Fort Memorial)
description: Raigad Samadhi is the final resting place of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, located atop the historic Raigad Fort. The site includes the samadhi (tomb), a grand statue, and the coronation platform (Nagarkhana Darwaja).
historicalSignificance: Site of Shivaji Maharaj's coronation (1674) and samadhi (1680). A place of immense reverence for all Maharashtrians.

landmarks.name: Statue of Shivaji Maharaj
landmarks.description: Grand equestrian statue at the site.

reviews: A place of deep reverence and pride.
The samadhi is well maintained and the views are stunning.
